team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Team ATK bonus from passive proc (enemy HP < 30%). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A longsword used by the Wolf Knight. Originally just a heavy sheet of iron given to the knight by a blacksmith from the city, it became endowed with legendary power owing to his friendship with the wolves.

refinements.1: Increases ATK by <r>20%</r>. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by <r>40%</r> for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.
refinements.2: Increases ATK by <r>25%</r>. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by <r>50%</r> for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.
refinements.3: Increases ATK by <r>30%</r>. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by <r>60%</r> for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.
refinements.4: Increases ATK by <r>35%</r>. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by <r>70%</r> for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.
refinements.5: Increases ATK by <r>40%</r>. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by <r>80%</r> for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.

fr.flavor: Une épée longue appartenant au chevalier aux loups. Il ne s'agissait au départ que d'une épaisse plaque de fer offerte par le forgeron de la ville, mais elle a acquis un pouvoir légendaire au côté des loups.

refinements.1: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>20 %</r>. Les attaques touchant les ennemis dont les PV sont inférieurs à 30 % augmentent l'ATQ de tous les membres de l'équipe de <r>40 %</r> pendant 12 s. Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 30 s.
